jobs.jdHtml:
We Are Hiring – DevSecOps Engineer
Experience: 1–5 Years
Location: Sector 63, Noida
Employment Type: Full-Time
Joining: Immediate Joiners Only
About Netcradus
Netcradus is a UK-based cybersecurity and technology company specialising in AI-powered cybersecurity solutions, advanced threat detection, security automation and software development. Our flagship product, ACIS (Autonomous Cyber Immune System), is designed to transform the cybersecurity landscape through intelligent security solutions.
Job Overview
We are looking for a skilled and passionate DevSecOps Engineer to join our growing technical team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for integrating security into the software development lifecycle, managing cloud infrastructure and ensuring secure, scalable and reliable application deployments.
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Design, implement and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines.
Integrate security tools and practices into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Manage cloud infrastructure, containerisation and deployment processes.
Perform vulnerability assessments, security scanning and remediation.
Implement infrastructure security, access controls and security monitoring.
Automate security testing, deployment and infrastructure management.
Manage Docker and Kubernetes environments.
Collaborate with development, cybersecurity and AI teams.
Implement security best practices and support compliance requirements.
Monitor infrastructure performance and respond to security incidents.
Required Skills & Qualifications
1–5 years of experience in DevSecOps, DevOps or Cloud Security.
Knowledge of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.
Knowledge of Terraform, Ansible and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SonarQube, Trivy and OWASP security standards.
Strong understanding of Linux, networking and cloud security.
Proficiency in Python, Bash or Shell scripting.
Knowledge of IAM, secrets management and vulnerability management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
How to Apply
Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@netcradus.com.
